text:
violet: quick thought: product wants a clear "amortized token" stat on tenant cards (raw vs amortized) so teams see prefetch impact.

sam: +1. single percent delta next to total burn sounds ideal. expand to per-route on click.

derek: implementation note: split prefetch cost by session-weighted usage within 5m window. materialize at 60s into TSDB to keep UI snappy.

violet: UX: show tokens and normalized USD. tooltip: 'Amortized = shared prefetch cost split across consumers in window'. link to docs.

sam: can we add a "what-if canary" preview to simulate savings for a given split? cheap sampled replay should be fine.

derek: yes, use 1% sampling traces to approximate. caveat in UI that results are estimates.

ops-bot: alert rule created: amortized_savings_drift -> page on 25% change in 15m. (ID: AR-210)

violet: action items: 1) materialize amortized_tokens @60s (derek), 2) tenant card UI + savings pct (sam), 3) canary preview API (derek+sam). I'll file RFC bullets for attribution keys.

sam: will mock UI and add tooltip content.

derek: will start TSDB proto and export schema.

violet: wrapping. last_message: 3270001178
